_readme: These are distances between MediaPipe JOINT landmarks, not tailoring
of a person's height) and 'hip' is hip-joint to hip-joint (roughly 0.12 of
height). They are NOT chest circumference or waist circumference.
The values below are starting estimates for adults. Retune them against
real customers before trusting them in a store: calibrate the camera, note
the centimetre reading for several people whose size you already know, and
Each row is [size name, from (inclusive), to (exclusive)].
